description: List the versions under an application, with their container image, resources, ports (including whether TLS Upgrade is on, which browser/WebGL clients need for wss://) and whether a registry login is set for pulling the image. Use this to find the version name to deploy, to check a version is ready before deploying, or to copy settings from a working version when creating a new one.

application.description: Application name, as returned by edgegap_list_apps.

name: edgegap_list_app_versions
title: List versions of an application
